result.summary: This PR adds three new unit tests to src/test/psbt_tests.cpp covering previously untested branches of PartiallySignedTransaction::Merge(): the version-mismatch check, the fallback_locktime merge logic, and the m_tx_modifiable AND-merge logic. The author identifies each gap using a specific code mutant that the existing test suite fails to catch, demonstrating the tests are not just filler. The author also raises a question about whether the fallback_locktime merge behavior (silent 'this wins' when both sides set it) is intentional.

open_concerns: Author asks whether silently letting 'this' side win when both PSBTs have conflicting fallback_locktime values is correct behavior, rather than erroring or taking the max; no maintainer has responded yet.

result.card: This PR adds three unit tests for PartiallySignedTransaction::Merge(), covering the version-mismatch check, fallback_locktime merging, and m_tx_modifiable merging, none of which had prior coverage. The author demonstrates concrete mutants of psbt.cpp that pass today's test suite silently, showing the coverage gap is real rather than cosmetic. The author also flags a behavioral question: when both PSBTs being merged have a fallback_locktime set, the receiving side silently wins, and it's unclear if that's intended versus erroring or taking the max.
